resources.string: Record cellular calls locally with the Shizuku audio service. Configure consent, destination, format and automatic capture.

Recording phone calls may require consent from all participants, depending on local law. AndroidControl does not notify the other party or determine whether recording is lawful. Check the rules that apply to each call. Recording may fail on some devices and cannot be guaranteed over VoLTE, Wi-Fi calling or Bluetooth.
I understand the consent requirements and will comply with applicable law.
No folder selected. Choose a folder to store recordings.
The actual audio captured depends on firmware. Test both voices and the saved file before relying on it.
Automatically record cellular calls when off-hook
Off by default. Off-hook includes outgoing dialing before the other party answers. Requires phone-state permission, a writable folder and active Shizuku. Android may block background starts.
